scope: Actual pre-repair RVV originals for the frozen QCP 40-kernel catalog, compared with all 419 local XNNPACK RVV C files plus frozen handwritten candidates from the author fork. Not a claim about every historical/unpublished XNNPACK file.
normalization: Remove comments and whitespace; compare entry bodies excluding signature; keep identifiers, constants, control flow and operation order. Lexical inequality does not prove independent authorship or lack of copied/rewritten code.
history_check_limitation: The separate partial XNNPACK history repository reported missing promisor objects; no successful all-history comparison is claimed.
